# Preserve approved creative design

- Follow [the creative-animation workflow](../skills/creative-animation/SKILL.md) for visual design work.
- Read [confirmed preferences](../../creative-library/preferences.md) before changing approved artwork.
- For the main-page animation, open [the owner's composition baseline](../../creative-library/projects/main-page-animation/composition-baseline.md) and its image. It defines layout and element density, not replacement house artwork.
- That exterior baseline applies only to the main page. The create-a-game area should feel inside the house, and each game needs its own setting-specific animation; these are future design directions, not permission to build/deploy them now. Reuse the quality workflow, not the homepage composition.
- The owner confirmed the restored first house and now explicitly requests dismantling/rebuilding it slightly wider, keeping that design. This authorizes architectural reconstruction, not switching houses or stretching the entire image. The wider rebuild remains unfinished; reject distorted or visibly seamed candidates. The shadow should visit all seven facade windows in randomized order.
- Keep reference originals, working files, experiments, and immutable snapshots in [the creative library](../../creative-library/README.md), not in published assets.
- Clarify consequential choices one question at a time. Record actual selections and distinguish confirmation from inference. Never invent owner approval.
